prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Select Companion Starting Temperament", "Choose how your companion behaves when it first lands on your desktop.", "Playful vs Calm Temperament"]
1: ["Calibrating Desktop Anchor Points", "Configuring display boundaries to ensure your companion drops cleanly onto your desktop.", "Calibrating screen bounds"]
2: ["Review Pet Personality & Traits", "Confirm your desktop companion's visual style and base traits before completing setup.", "Companion Trait Summary", "Confirm Traits"]
3: ["Choose Your Onboarding Journey", "Select whether you'd like to pick an instant preset companion or generate a unique pet from photo uploads.", "Explore Options"]
4: ["Official Desktop Adoption Certificate", "Name your new desktop companion to finalize adoption.", "Companion Name", "Official Desktop Pet"]
5: ["Select Your Desktop Pet Experience", "Swipe to compare preset pet adoption against custom image generation."]
6: ["Initializing Desktop Companion Graphics", "Your pet is loading render shaders and preparing to step onto your screen."]
7: ["Signing in attaches your companion to your account so your pet progress is preserved whenever you sign in."]
8: ["Your pet resides in your desktop tray. Right-click its tray icon anytime to open pet controls."]
9: ["Sign In to Save Companion Progress", "Quickly sign in to attach your new pet to your account."]
